annotations.title: Corridor news for a pair or currency

description: Dated corridor news for a currency pair or one currency: provider route launches and exits, licences granted or revoked, central-bank FX and payment rule changes, devaluations, limit changes and outages, collected from payments press and regulator feeds across Africa, Latin America, Asia, the Middle East and Turkey. Each event carries its source link and an evidence label: 'official source' (a regulator or central bank published it), 'announced, unverified' (a company or the press reported it), or 'headline only, not read'. Listed newest first; route launches for the exact pair come back separately as announced_routes, never as payment options. Free.

currency.description: One ISO code, e.g. NGN, when no pair is given.

kind.description: Optional comma-separated kinds: route_launch, route_exit, licence_granted, licence_revoked, rule_change, devaluation, limit_change, outage, partnership, other.

pair.description: Six letters, e.g. NGNCNY. Matches either currency or the exact corridor.
